whyItMatters: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a `path` key inside a `[workspace.dependencies]` entry.
actions: Depend on a published, versioned artifact, and keep local paths or branch references out of the committed manifest. Specifically: fix a `path` key inside a `[workspace.dependencies]` entry.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm Cargo.toml no longer carries a `path` key inside a `[workspace.dependencies]` entry.
